info.title: DeeplyDepBuilder
info.description: Build All Transative Project References / Dependencies of the Given Project

options.name: --project
options.description: Required. .Net Project or Solution Full Path

options.name: --clean
options.description:
(Default: false) Do Dotnet Clean instead of
Dotnet Build

options.name: --generate-graph-path
options.description:
Generate markdown file for graph visualization in
given path

options.name: --hide-path-in-graph
options.description:
(Default: false) In visual graph, if false shows
path otherwise File name. Use only when names are
unique

options.name: --no-parallel
options.description:
(Default: false) If false builds projects in the
same level in parallelly otherwise sequentially

options.name: --show-build-output
options.description:
(Default: false) If True shows the build output
in the console
